extras.agent_focus: Government, municipal and public-sector hosting that accepts citizen deposits. Decisive axis: can an INDIVIDUAL (not an agency) publish, at what identity cost, at what per-file cap, and are published files anonymously retrievable afterwards. Probed CKAN write paths empirically (unauth organization_create, /user/register, owner_org distribution over 300-dataset samples) rather than trusting marketing copy.
